scripts.start:api: cd services/api && npm install && node server.js
scripts.install:all: cd services/api && npm install && cd ../ui && npm install
scripts.version: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const v = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./package.json', 'utf8')).version; ['package-lock.json', 'services/api/package.json', 'services/ui/package.json', 'services/api/package-lock.json', 'services/ui/package-lock.json'].forEach(f => { if (fs.existsSync(f)) { const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); p.version = v; if (p.packages && p.packages['']) p.packages[''].version = v; fs.writeFileSync(f, JSON.stringify(p, null, 2) + '\n'); } });" && git add package.json package-lock.json services/api/package*.json services/ui/package*.json
